symptoms: Dark brown to black concentric rings (target-like spots) on lower/older leaves first. Yellowing around spots. Leaves dry up and fall. Can affect stems and fruit.
chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP (2-2.5g/L) every 7-10 days as preventive. For active infection: Azoxystrobin (1ml/L) or Chlorothalonil (2g/L). Alternate chemicals to prevent resistance.
organic_treatment: Neem oil (5ml/L) every 10 days. Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide (5g/L). Copper-based sprays. Mulching to prevent soil splash.
prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds. 3-year crop rotation. Remove infected debris. Proper plant spacing (60cm). Avoid overhead irrigation. Use drip irrigation.
severity: Moderate to High. Can cause 50-80% yield loss if untreated.

symptoms: Water-soaked, dark green to brown spots on leaves, starting from tips and edges. White fuzzy mold on underside (in humid conditions). Rapid wilting and plant death. Brown firm rot on fruit.
chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold MZ, 2g/L). Cymoxanil + Mancozeb. Copper oxychloride (3g/L). Start spraying before symptoms in humid weather.
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%). Copper-based organic fungicides. Remove infected plants immediately. Do not compost infected material.
prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead watering. Use drip irrigation. Good air circulation. Remove volunteer plants. Apply preventive sprays during humid/rainy periods.
severity: Very High. Can destroy entire crop in 7-10 days during favorable conditions.

symptoms: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves, stems, and fruit. Spots may have yellow halo. Severe defoliation. Raised scab-like spots on fruit.
chemical_treatment: Copper hydroxide (2g/L) + Streptocycline (0.5g/L). Kasugamycin. Apply at first sign of disease. Repeat every 7 days.
organic_treatment: Copper-based sprays. Remove and destroy infected plants. Avoid working in wet fields.
prevention: Use disease-free seeds (hot water treated). Avoid overhead irrigation. Proper spacing. Crop rotation (2-3 years). Clean tools between plants.

symptoms: Yellow spots on upper leaf surface. Olive-green to gray fuzzy mold on underside. Leaves curl and dry. Common in greenhouses with high humidity.
chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil (2g/L). Mancozeb (2.5g/L). Copper oxychloride. Improve ventilation in greenhouse.
organic_treatment: Improve air circulation. Reduce humidity. Neem oil (5ml/L). Remove lower leaves for airflow.
prevention: Maintain humidity below 85%. Proper ventilation. Wide spacing. Use resistant varieties. Drip irrigation only.

symptoms: Numerous small, circular spots (1-3mm) with dark borders and gray/tan centers. Tiny black dots (pycnidia) visible in centers. Starts on lower leaves.
chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil (2g/L). Mancozeb (2.5g/L). Copper-based fungicides. Start when first spots appear.
organic_treatment: Copper sprays. Remove infected lower leaves. Mulch around plants. Neem oil.
prevention: Crop rotation. Remove plant debris. Mulching. Avoid overhead watering. Use resistant varieties.
severity: Moderate. Defoliation reduces fruit size and quality.

symptoms: Olive-brown velvety spots on leaves and fruit. Distorted fruit shape. Premature leaf drop. Cracked and corky spots on fruit.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb (2.5g/L) as preventive from green tip stage. Myclobutanil (0.5ml/L) as curative. Captan (2g/L). Apply before rain events.
organic_treatment: Sulfur-lime spray. Neem oil. Remove fallen leaves (primary inoculum source).
prevention: Plant resistant varieties (Gala, Fuji). Remove fallen leaves in autumn. Prune for air circulation. Apply dormant sprays.
severity: High for susceptible varieties. Causes unmarketable fruit.

symptoms: Reddish-brown expanding leaf lesions. 'Frog-eye' leaf spots. Fruit rot with concentric rings. Mummified fruit remaining on tree. Cankers on branches.
chemical_treatment: Captan (2g/L). Thiophanate-methyl. Mancozeb. Apply from pink bud through cover sprays.
organic_treatment: Copper sprays (dormant season). Remove mummified fruit. Prune cankers 15cm below visible edge.
prevention: Remove mummified fruit and cankered branches. Practice good orchard sanitation. Prune for airflow.
severity: Moderate to High. Fruit rot can cause major losses.

symptoms: White powdery coating on leaf surfaces. Stunted growth. Leaf curling and distortion. Premature leaf drop. Affects young tissues most.
chemical_treatment: Sulfur WP (3g/L). Carbendazim (1g/L). Hexaconazole (1ml/L). Triadimefon. Alternate modes of action.
organic_treatment: Milk spray (40% milk + 60% water). Baking soda (1 tsp/L). Neem oil (5ml/L). Potassium bicarbonate.
prevention: Proper air circulation and spacing. Avoid overcrowding. Full sun exposure. Resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation.
severity: Moderate. Reduces photosynthesis, yield, and fruit quality.

symptoms: Small, circular to elongated, reddish-brown pustules (raised bumps) on both leaf surfaces. Pustules release powdery, rust-colored spores when rubbed.
chemical_treatment: Propiconazole (1ml/L). Mancozeb (2.5g/L). Azoxystrobin. Apply at first sign of pustules.
organic_treatment: Remove heavily infected leaves. Use resistant hybrids. Crop rotation.
prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Early planting. Balanced nutrition. Remove crop residue.
severity: Low to Moderate in resistant varieties. High in susceptible sweet corn.

symptoms: Dark, concentric ring spots (target spots) on older/lower leaves. Yellowing and premature death of leaves from bottom up. Can affect tubers (dark, sunken lesions).
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb (2.5g/L). Chlorothalonil (2g/L). Azoxystrobin for severe cases. Apply 7-day intervals during vine growth.
organic_treatment: Neem oil. Trichoderma viride. Copper-based sprays. Mulching.
prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed. 2-3 year rotation. Adequate fertilization (K, N). Destroy volunteer plants. Irrigate early in day.

symptoms: Water-soaked, pale green to dark brown spots on leaf tips/edges. White mold on underside in humid conditions. Rapid death of vines. Tuber rot (reddish-brown granular decay).
chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold, 2g/L). Cymoxanil. Dimethomorph. Apply preventively during cool, wet weather.
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%). Copper hydroxide. Destroy infected plants immediately. Do not compost.
prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Certified disease-free seed. Avoid overhead irrigation. Hills high for tuber protection. Monitor weather forecasts.
severity: Very High. Can destroy entire field in 1-2 weeks. Irish Potato Famine was caused by this disease.

symptoms: Asymmetric yellowing (blotchy mottle) of leaves. Small, lopsided, bitter fruit. Green color retention on fruit. Stunted growth. Eventually kills the tree.
chemical_treatment: No cure exists. Control psyllid vector with Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L), Dimethoate. Antibiotic trunk injections (experimental). Nutritional sprays to prolong tree life.
organic_treatment: Release parasitoid wasps (Tamarixia radiata) for psyllid control. Neem oil. Remove infected trees to prevent spread.
prevention: Plant certified disease-free nursery stock. Scout and control Asian citrus psyllid. Remove infected trees. Use windbreaks.
severity: Very High. No cure. Tree dies within 3-5 years. Most destructive citrus disease worldwide.
